Senses.Explanation: To make the mallet proclamation is the formal announce-and-strike action performed by the hall officer; the first graph names proclamation, not the color of the implement. The witnesses identify the hall coordinator making the proclamation, preserve its formula, or mark what follows its completion. They do not establish a white-colored mallet.
